name: competitor-pricing-intelligence-agent
description: Automatically discover, monitor, and analyze competitor pricing using You.com APIs, Insforge, and OpenRouter.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
